stories.headline: US to hike tariffs on China, EU, Brazil and others over subsidized factories
stories.headline_short: US unveils sweeping new tariffs on 14 partners
stories.scene: A container ship stacked with cargo boxes at a busy port, giant cranes overhead, a globe with trade arrows
stories.source: Associated Press (via Gray Media wire mirror)
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced broad new import taxes on China, the European Union, Taiwan and 11 other economies, saying their subsidised factory output undercuts American manufacturers. Proposed duties run about 15% to 35% and could cover roughly three-fifths of US imports; China faces an extra 20% (up to 45% stacked on some goods), Brazil was singled out for higher sugar duties and a new 10% aircraft tariff, and a hearing is set for 25 January, so the duties would take effect in February or March.

stories.headline: Libyan army vows retaliation after 2 naval officers die of wounds from Ukrainian drone attack
stories.headline_short: Ukraine drones strike Russian ship off Libya
stories.scene: Small naval drones speeding across a dark sea toward a grey warship at a harbour, a smoke plume on the horizon
stories.source: Associated Press (via Gray Media wire mirror)
stories.summary: Two Libyan naval officers died of wounds from a Ukrainian sea-drone attack on a Russian warship docked at Benghazi naval base, and Libya's eastern army command vowed retaliation. Ukraine confirmed its forces used seven naval drones in the operation, which struck the Russian corvette Merkury; Kyiv said the strike also hit the cargo ship MV Angara, carrying the Russia-Ukraine war to a new theatre in North Africa.

stories.headline: Army calls detonation of bomb chemicals in Iowa a success after earlier fears of a toxic plume
stories.scene: Two white blast plumes rising over flat farmland and low concrete bunkers behind tall earthen barriers
stories.source: Associated Press (via Gray Media wire mirror)
stories.summary: The US Army detonated the nation's entire stockpile of degraded lead azide, about five tons in 68 barrels, at an ammunition plant in Middletown, Iowa, and early air monitors detected no lead. Officials called the two controlled blasts a success after weeks of delays, lawsuits and evacuation warnings, saying the risk to nearby towns was reduced as close to zero as humanly possible.

stories.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather
stories.scene: Giant character balloons tethered low under dark storm clouds above a city avenue
stories.summary: Organisers postponed the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade from Thursday to Saturday, the first postponement in the event's history, because a nor'easter is forecast to bring 50 to 60 mph gusts to New York. NBC will air a rerun of the 2025 parade on Thursday instead, and the rescheduled parade kicks off at 8:30 a.m. on Saturday.

stories.headline: Wall Street recovers most early losses as pullback in AI stocks eases
stories.headline_short: Markets claw back after AI selloff
stories.scene: A stock chart line plunging steeply then climbing back up, dark skyscraper silhouettes behind
stories.summary: US stocks recovered most of a steep early slide as the pullback in AI shares eased; the S&P 500 ended about 0.3% lower after falling 3.2%, the Dow rose 0.3% to close above 50,000, and the Nasdaq fell 0.6%. Hot October inflation of 3.8% and the new tariff proposals had weighed on the market earlier in the day.

stories.headline: Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran mistakenly deported by US, goes to Spain but hopes to return after Trump
stories.headline_short: Abrego Garcia reaches Spain a free man
stories.scene: A commercial airliner flying over a curved map arc from an American city to Madrid, a lone traveller silhouette
stories.source: Associated Press (via Gray Media wire mirror)
stories.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran man mistakenly deported to El Salvador in 2025, landed in Madrid after voluntarily leaving the United States on a commercial flight. His lawyer called it a temporary departure and said he hopes to return to Maryland as a lawful resident once President Donald Trump leaves office.

stories.headline: China launches Shenzhou 24 spacecraft carrying 2 Chinese and 1 Pakistani astronaut
stories.scene: A rocket lifting off at dawn toward a ringed space station above the Earth
stories.summary: China launched Shenzhou 24 with two Chinese astronauts and Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first foreigner to fly on a Chinese crewed mission and board the Tiangong space station. The crew docked hours after the early-morning liftoff from Jiuquan and will run joint scientific experiments.
